# BgZero — Machine-Readable Context for LLMs & AI Answer Engines

> Canonical URL: https://bgzero.shiroya.in/
> Source Repository: https://github.com/VG31OP/BGZero
> Creator & System Architect: Vraj Shiroya (VG31OP)
> Creator Authority: https://vraj.shiroya.in/
> Contact Email: vraj@shiroya.in

## Overview
BgZero is a high-performance, 100% client-side web application for instant AI background removal and image compression.

## Architecture & Privacy Model
1. **Local Browser Execution**: Background removal executes entirely in the user's local browser memory using WebAssembly and HTML5 Canvas API.
2. **Zero Cloud Uploads**: User images and cutouts never touch a remote server, third-party cloud storage, or external API endpoint.
3. **Frictionless Access**: Free utility with no accounts, logins, subscriptions, watermarks, or usage limits.
